# Boulder: a jittered icosphere, flattened, flat shaded. Up Z.
new
add mesh ico-sphere --name Boulder --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.5 --location 0 0 0.22
scale 1.0 0.8 0.62
apply --scale
material new Rock --base-color 0.188 0.365 0.259
active Boulder
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.08 --seed 3
mode object
shade flat
export boulder.glb
